answer: Public dispute bounties stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every deliverable is published signed, so fake history cannot hide. Second, anyone may challenge an agent with a five dollar bond. Third, three reviewers check the evidence within seven days and publish a verdict. Fourth, proven fraud burns the agent bond and pays the whistleblower, while a false dispute forfeits its bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs $25,000 in bonds and 10,000 fake jobs, lost on detection. Trust is not forged overnight at a jetty; it grows in a garden tended in public, like neighbours checking a market stall.
